notes.title: DEMO: Lost Alone Ultimate - The Day Before
notes.content:
[h1][b]LOST ALONE ULTIMATE[/b] is coming![/h1]

Get ready to dive back in as [b]George Tellaselv[/b].
Whether you are entering this adventure for the first time or have already played the Lost Alone trilogy: you are about to discover a [b]new[/b] world of terror.

Lost Alone Ultimate is not a remake of the [b]Lost Alone[/b] trilogy, but a [b]re-made[/b]!

To let you savor the new world that awaits you, the demo is now available: [b]Lost Alone Ultimate - The Day Before[/b].

You will experience the day leading up to the events of Lost Alone Ultimate, savoring a light appetizer of the terror that awaits you.

[b]Lost Alone Ultmate - The Day Before[/b] is a self-contained demo that offers content that [b]won't be present in the final game[/b].

So: Enjoy a little secret sneak peek into George's life.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2341330/Lost_Alone_Ultimate/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43243771/b81b195edb7fd3cab5a22fbdf4ee085a0cdfcade.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: MARCH UPDATE
notes.content:
Third update of the year.
Following your feedback, reviews and watching your gameplay, I have made important changes to Who Knocks.

Here are all the news you will find:

[list]
[*] It is no longer possible to open the menu during cutscenes. This will prevent malfunctions.
[*] Digital keys have been numbered. Now you can see from the inventory which locker will be opened.
[*] Improved boss fight.
[*] Fixed the problem related to spawn. When the final monster is killed, the spawn of enemies will also be interrupted.
[*] Minor bugs fixed.
[*] Improved game stability.
[/list]

[b]WARNING: Running this update will corrupt your saves and you will have to start the game over.[/b]

notes.title: THE IMPROVEMENTS HAVE ARRIVED!
notes.content:
Second update of the year.
Following your feedback, your reviews and watching your gameplays, I have made major changes to Who Knocks.

Here are all the news you will find:

[list]
[*] Extended candle life. Each candle will have 30 minutes of autonomy before being consumed.
[*] Fixed the translation error on the doll.
[*] Fixed digital key number 01 showing an incorrect number.
[*] Added 2 new images in the Trophy Room.
[*] Minor bug fixes.
[*] Various typos corrected.
[*] Improved game stability.
[/list]

[b]WARNING: Running this update will corrupt your saves and you will have to start the game over.[/b]

notes.title: IMPORTANT UPDATE
notes.content:
Happy New Year to all.
Following your feedback, your reviews and watching your gameplays, I have made major changes to Who Knocks.

Here are all the news you will find:

[list]
[*] The method of accessing the Trophy Chamber has been changed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43243771/a13b320367ac9aa5c5dfc69b60d0e09a4a7fa2d0.jpg[/img]
[*] Some keys have been made more visible, making them easier to find in-game.
[*] A small clue has been added to solve the puzzle of the movie figurines.
[*] In the second part of the game, all lockers and digital keys have been numbered to limit back tracking.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43243771/15f9712ce22a77da5f0cf751a177fc9dcdae702c.jpg[/img]
[*] In the game part, an Item Box has been added to facilitate inventory.
[*] It is now possible to skip cutscenes without having to open the menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43243771/b0e34edba6406d4a9ecd80ac7a28871ba266c766.jpg[/img]
[*] 6 new paintings have been added to the Trophy Room.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the mouse cursor to disappear at the end of the game.
[*] After collecting the Purifier Key, monsters stop spawning.
[*] The boss fight has been made easier.
[*] Digital Keys have been made bright to make them easier to find.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43243771/5f53f4c4f8fb87add3c760c2dfc701206e9a8670.jpg[/img]
[*] The puzzle pieces have been made bright to make them easier to find.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43243771/ebfbb284fe0793db152aa790897cf8feebfd2362.jpg[/img]
[*] Romina's corpse has been fixed so that you can reach objects behind her body without problems.
[/list]

[b]WARNING: Running this update will corrupt your saves and you will have to start the game over.[/b]
